checks.text: Uploading a JPEG receipt photo shows a thumbnail in the list with "Receipt 1" as the label.
Clicking "Add Another Receipt" lets the user upload a second PNG receipt photo.
After adding two receipts, clicking "Generate PDF" creates a downloadable PDF with both receipts and a cover sheet.
The cover sheet lists each receipt's date and amount, extracted from the image.
The PDF is saved with the filename "Receipt Packet_2025-04-05.pdf".
Selecting "Send to Expenses App" opens the user's default expenses app with the PDF attached.
Cropping a receipt photo using the on-screen tool adjusts the image to the correct size.
Rotating a receipt photo straightens the image to a horizontal orientation.
Reload keeps the list of uploaded receipts with their original labels and thumbnails.
